### The Father’s Gift to Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fathers-gift-to-christ
Passage: John 17:6
Points:
- Jesus identifies His disciples as a sovereign gift given to Him by the Father out of the fallen world.
- Although believers remain in the created world, they no longer belong to the system in rebellion against God.
- The disciples' adherence to God's word demonstrates authentic faith and perseverance despite their human flaws.
- Divine election humbles believers by reminding them that salvation is entirely God's work, not their own.

### Read the Bible: 2 Chronicles 32, Revelation 18, Zechariah 14, and John 17
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/2-chronicles-32-revelation-18-zechariah-14-john-17/
Passage: John 17:17-19
Points:
- Biblical usage of sanctification in this context differs from later systematic definitions of progressive moral growth.
- Jesus sanctifying Himself refers to His total consecration to the Father's will in going to the cross.
- Through Christ's atoning work, His followers are positionally sanctified and decisively set apart for God.
- Jesus petitions the Father to sanctify believers by truth, anchoring their consecration and walk in God's Word.
